name: XPeng Inc.
blurb: XPeng Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, and markets smart electric vehicles (EVs) in China. Its product lineup includes sedans (P7, P7i, Next P7), SUVs (G9, G6, G7), an MPV (X9), and the MONA M03 hatchback. The company competes in the rapidly growing Chinese EV market, focusing on advanced technology and autonomous driving features.
recent: As of May 8, 2026, XPEV closed at $15.62, with a market cap of $14.93B and revenue growth of 87.7% year-over-year. The stock is down 24.5% year-to-date and trades near its 52-week low of $15.38. Analysts give a Buy rating with a price target of $23.08, implying 47.76% upside.
